Lost property

Any lost or found property is held by Security for a period of six weeks. Lost or found items, including bicycles, can be reclaimed or reported to the Security Reception, Aston Webb Building.

Security Opening hours:

  • Monday to Friday - 09:00 - 16:30
  • Telephone - +44 (0)121 414 3114

After six weeks any unclaimed property is passed on to Acorns Children's Charity for re-sale.

Further information relating to campus safety and security can be found on the Security web pages.

Enterprise and Innovation

Our aim is to support the University in meeting two aspects of its Mission, to:

  • Maintain the International reputation for the highest quality of scholarship and research
  • Promote social and cultural well-being and to aid economic growth and regeneration in the Birmingham and West Midlands region

Proof of Study letters, Transcripts and references for graduates/alumni

Students and graduates can use our Secure Documents Service to view, share and download their degree documents and secure letters to give proof of study at the University, for a range of purposes.

Third party organisations and companies can also use the Secure Documents Service to verify attendance at the University, check qualifications, and view degree documents.

IT Service Portal (forgotten password, unable to access account etc)

Use the IT Service Portal to find answers, change your password, or report a problem. If you don’t know your username or password, use the ‘I can’t login’ option when prompted to access the guest form.

Reference requests for former employees

You can contact our HR Department on workhere@contacts.bham.ac.uk.

Connecting with our Careers Network as an employer

Find out about connecting with our Careers Network, including promoting vacancies and attending recruitment events, via our Employer Relations team.
